members.hint: Every agent can use its own model and tool permissions.

model.sourceHint: Pick a model for this agent, or let it follow the session.

tools.toolAccessHint: Allow only the listed tools, or all session tools.
tools.allowListHint: Tool names or scopes, for example read_file or bash:git log:*. An empty allow list blocks every tool.
tools.denyListHint: These tools stay blocked for this agent.
tools.networkHint: Whether the agent may reach the network.
tools.writeScopeHint: Inside the project is a hard boundary: direct file writes outside the project root are denied. Shell, code execution, subagents, background tasks and MCP tools are blocked because their writes cannot be confined.
tools.requireApprovalHint: Confirm high-risk operations before running them.

collaboration.modeHint: How agents hand work to each other.
